# SP-DECODE — GitHub About profile

**Important:** This file prepares recommended **GitHub About** metadata. Adding it does **not** automatically modify the repository's description, website or topics.

An authorized maintainer can apply the values at **GitHub → SP-DECODE → About → gear icon**.

## Description (recommended, English)

> Offline Android configuration decoder and self-hosted Telegram bot supporting 60 VPN/tunnel file formats and text links.

> Decodificador offline para Android y bot de Telegram con 60 formatos VPN/túnel y enlaces de configuración.

## GitHub presentation checklist

- [ ] Apply About description.
- [ ] Set Website to the official Releases page.
- [ ] Set repository topics.
- [ ] Verify that Issues remains enabled for sanitized reports.
- [ ] Pin the repository on the maintainer profile (optional).
- [ ] Decide whether to enable Discussions and assign moderation ownership.
- [ ] Choose an explicit license **only after verifying code and third-party redistribution rights**.

**Licensing:** the repository currently has no LICENSE file; avoid claiming MIT, GPL or other permissions without the owner's decision.

The connected GitHub action supports file changes but does not expose a repository About metadata update operation. These settings must therefore be applied by a repository maintainer in the web UI.
